articles.summary: TiVo appoints industry veteran Tal Bone as general manager of TiVo OS as platform continues momentum across Europe and global markets TiVo Platform Technologies LLC (“ TiVo ”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER), today announced significant enhancements to TiVo OS, its leading independent media platform, delivering new generative AI-powered content discovery experiences, expanded free streaming content, enhanced sports experiences, interactive commerce capabilities and platform optimizations that are expected to reduce costs for smart TV manufacturers. TiVo also announced the appointment of Tal Bone as senior vice president and general manager of TiVo OS. Tal brings more than a decade of experience building and scaling global smart TV and entertainment platforms. Most recently, he served as vice president of global product and chief technology officer at VIDAA, Hisense's smart TV operating system, where he helped grow the platform to more than 40 million monthly
